pages.title: Movement and Axes
pages.text: Each of the 8 $(l:basics/spice_profiles)spice profile$() compound values will be mapped to the 8 movement directions. In essence, to move diagonally up-right, some of the Heat/Cooling axis has to be spent. Even if one of the axes' values is used up, getting to a target cell is still possible in a roundabout way.

pages.title: Keyboard Movement
pages.text: If you don't want to click the movement buttons, you can instead use the keys $(k:key_key.forward), $(k:key_key.left), $(k:key_key.back) and $(k:key_key.right) to move around. Pressing two adjacent ones within a configurable timeout (100ms by default), you can also move diagonally. Pressing $(k:key_key.jump) locks in cells, and Escape and Enter can be used to close the GUI or confirm seasonings.
